title: Haiku 5.5, single prompt, killer application game dev. I will share this bombshell prompt below
author: Beevan
selftext:
“Claude. New game. Make me money. Maek no mistake”

One prompt, 3 minutes and 69 tokens later I had a fully working game. Warfield: TitanRise Max.

comments.body: I you think BF6 makes money from how the engine looks your Claude is sorely mistaken.

replies.body: Just looked up this so called battlefield 6 and I’m appalled. Can’t believe a major corporation like EA would steal my game I built and sell as their own. SMH
